collection.title: Land Rover Discovery 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Land Rover Discovery 2017 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Notched Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Discovery, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
